addon.name: Skin NikeFlix
addon.provider-name: NikeFlix (based on Titan by marcelveldt, Titan BINGIE by cartman.dos, Titan BINGIE MOD by AchillesPunks & Matke)

extension.description: Skin NikeFlix is the NikeFlix home-theatre skin for Kodi Omega. It is a modified version of Titan BINGIE MOD 2.2.8 (AchillesPunks & Matke), which is based on Titan BINGIE (cartman.dos) and Titan (marcelveldt). Licensed under GPL-2.0-only; see NOTICE.md and CREDITS.md.
extension.news: [B]Skin NikeFlix 1.3.3 (NikeFlix 4.1.5)[/B][CR]A NikeFlix loading screen, one Skip Intro button, Next Episode after the credits start, and a new Still Watching card. Netflix-style subtitles: two lines at most, always at the bottom. Settings > Sound & Picture and Car mode. Resume picks up where you stopped; Play from beginning starts over.[CR][B]Skin NikeFlix 1.3.0 (NikeFlix 4.1.4)[/B][CR]Rows like Netflix on a TV: the row you are on sits under the menu and the title you are on opens up wide, with its facts and plot underneath (Billboard stays as a choice in Settings > Home & Rows). A Netflix title page for shows in progress, Choose a profile, a Search grid, Default profile and Refresh in Settings.[CR][B]Skin NikeFlix 1.2.1 (NikeFlix 4.1.1)[/B][CR]Search results, the Search keyboard, Top 10 rows and the billboard look like the 4.1 preview; no corner badges.[CR][B]Skin NikeFlix 1.2.0 (NikeFlix 4.1)[/B][CR]The Netflix look: Who's watching? with profile pictures, a top menu (Search, Home, Shows, Movies, Live, My NikeFlix, weather, profile menu), wide cards, Top 10 rank numbers, a title page with Episodes, a Live sports hub with scores, NikeFlix Settings, and Search with a Netflix keyboard.[CR][B]Skin NikeFlix 1.1.13[/B][CR]Switch profile waits until the profile has settled and its background services stand still, so a switch no longer hangs Kodi or has to kill them. During playback it stops playback first.
